title: Some people watch the world…
paragraphs:
Some people watch the world…
others warn it.
God told the prophet Ezekiel something powerful.
If a watchman sees danger coming and sounds the trumpet, the people have a chance to prepare.
But if the watchman sees danger and stays silent, their blood is on his hands.

Today the world is full of watchers —
people scrolling, commenting, analyzing.
But God still asks a different question:

Not with anger.
Not with pride.

A true watchman doesn’t speak to be popular.
A true watchman speaks because silence would be disobedience.

Because as long as the trumpet sounds…
people still have time to turn back to God.

Question:
Do you think the Church today has enough watchmen?
